metadata.title: RAPPORTSdes membres de la section française du jury international sur l'ensemble de l'exposition.

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The text features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and flat, unbracketed serifs characteristic of the Didone style (similar to Didot or Bodoni), which was the standard for formal French printing in the 19th century.
